# Meridian Analytics — Q3 2026 Business Report

**Period:** July 1 – September 7, 2026
**Prepared by:** Rachel Kim, VP of Sales | Claire Fontaine, CFO
**Distribution:** Executive Team

---

## Executive Summary

Q3 2026 marks another strong quarter for Meridian Analytics. Across our 15-person team we
closed 14 deals out of 22 opportunities, generating **$1,040,000** in new
contract value. The sales pipeline remains healthy with several high-value deals in the
pending stage. Customer support ticket volume held steady, with critical issues resolved
same-day in all cases.

---

## Sales Performance

Total closed revenue for the quarter reached **$1,040,000**, with the **South**
region leading all territories at **$468,000** in won deals. Our three-person
field sales team — James Okafor, Sofia Delgado, and Marcus Webb — collectively worked
22 active opportunities during the period.

Product mix shifted toward Meridian Insights Pro, which accounted for the majority of
closed revenue. Meridian DataBridge continues to serve as a strong land-and-expand vehicle
with several upsell opportunities maturing in Q4.

Win rate for the quarter stood at **63.6%**, slightly above the company
target of 55%. Three deals totalling approximately $240,000 remain in pending status and
are expected to close by end of September.

---

## Key Highlights

- **Top deal:** Sofia Delgado closed a $198,000 Meridian Insights Pro contract with a
  Southern-region enterprise customer on September 5 (D019).
- **Team headcount:** Meridian Analytics closes Q3 at 15 employees across five departments:
  Sales (4), Engineering (5), Product (3), HR (1), and Finance (2).
- **Support SLA:** All critical-priority tickets (TKT-004, TKT-011, TKT-015) were resolved
  within 24 hours of creation.
- **License utilisation:** SKU-001 (Meridian Insights Pro) is at 94% capacity — a
  procurement review is scheduled for October.

---

## Next Steps

1. Close the three pending deals (D007, D013, D020, D022) before Q3 end.
2. Begin Q4 pipeline review — target $1.2M in new ARR.
3. Resolve the open support tickets (TKT-013, TKT-016, TKT-019) ahead of quarterly
   customer success calls.
4. Conduct a license capacity review for SKU-001 and SKU-003 in early October.
5. HR to initiate two new engineering hire approvals with Kenji Obi to support Q4 roadmap.

---

1. Q3 SALES REVIEW
-------------------
Rachel Kim opened with a summary of Q3 performance.

- Total revenue closed (won deals): $1,040,000 across 14 closed-won deals.
- 22 total deals worked in the quarter; win rate 63.6%.
- South region led all territories at $468,000 in closed revenue.
- Largest single deal: D019 — Sofia Delgado — $198,000 — Meridian Insights Pro
  (signed September 5, Southern enterprise account).
- Pipeline carry-over into Q4: D007 ($7,800), D013 ($105,000), D020 ($115,000),
  D022 ($11,000) — total pending ~$239,300.

James Okafor noted that the North region pipeline is especially strong heading into Q4,
with two new prospects from the BostonTech conference (see EX001 travel expense).

Action: Rachel to circulate updated forecast by EOD September 9.

2. ENGINEERING & PRODUCT UPDATE
---------------------------------
Priya Nair reported that the DataBridge connector reached 28/30 license utilisation
(SKU-003) and a capacity upgrade is under evaluation for Q4.

Hannah Park flagged that Custom Dashboard Builder (SKU-009) is at 22/25 seats; renewal
in February 2027 should include a seat expansion.

Daniel Torres confirmed the new Meridian Connector - REST (SKU-005) rollout is complete.
Eleven of twenty available licenses are now provisioned.

Three open support tickets (TKT-013, TKT-016, TKT-019) were reviewed. Liam Chen and
Tom Reyes are owners; target closure by September 12.

3. FINANCE SNAPSHOT
--------------------
Claire Fontaine presented a brief Q3 finance summary.

- Five unapproved expense items remain outstanding (EX005, EX010, EX012, EX020, EX023,
  EX025). Total: ~$1,050. Oscar Mensah to chase approvals by September 10.
- Hardware spend is tracking within budget. SKU-013 (HIPAA Compliance Pack) renews
  October 31 at $15,000 — renewal decision needed by September 26.

4. HR UPDATE
-------------
Kenji Obi confirmed headcount is stable at 15. Two engineering hire requisitions will be
submitted to the board in Q4 to support the roadmap expansion outlined by Priya.

New joiner orientation materials (see onboarding_guide.md) have been refreshed for the
updated tool stack.
